name: API Gateway Demo: Go Microservices behind Kong
description: Built five Go microservices (catalog, orders, payments, notifications, and a BFF) behind Kong Gateway on GKE to demonstrate routing, JWT and API-key auth, rate limiting, versioning, caching, and canary releases.
Wrote a backend-for-frontend in Go that calls three upstream services in parallel and merges their responses into a single payload.
Instrumented the services with OpenTelemetry and Prometheus, so a single request yields a five-span trace in Cloud Trace with its logs linked to it.
Built a Go load generator that streams live results over SSE (req/s, p95, p99, status codes) and lets the audience drive traffic from their phones.

name: Dependency-Free Discord Bot in Go
description: Built a Discord bot for a cloud native community using only the Go standard library, with no third-party dependencies.
Implemented an RFC 6455 WebSocket client from scratch (handshake, framing, masking, and close) to hold a persistent session with the Discord gateway.
Wrote the Discord REST client and slash-command routing, with guild-scoped command registration so changes take effect immediately.
Shipped it as a Docker image with secrets encrypted by sops and age, and graceful shutdown on OS signals.
